content: Insurance agent Suresh Deshmukh emailed customer Aditi Mahajan to confirm that a $1,200 refund for her cancelled auto policy (AU-2019-HC) was processed to her card ending in 1234 on September 27, 2026, providing transaction reference REF-20260927-1200 and a receipt. Aditi replied confirming receipt of the funds and that everything is correct.
